missions.name: LAST STAND
missions.objective: At the end of a Battle Round, control an objective that has a friendly unit Below Half-Strength in its Objective Area.

discarded.name: OBJECTIVE RELAY
discarded.objective: Move a unit that was within an Objective Area at Mission entry to a different Objective Area.

primary.name: STRATEGICAL DISRUPTION
primary.objective: From the second Battle Round, at the end of each Battle Round, score 1 VP if an enemy unit in an Objective Area is SUPPRESSED or you destroyed an enemy unit in an Objective Area during that Battle Round, and 2 VP if your opponent's Primary Mission scored no VP during that Battle Round. If your opponent also holds STRATEGICAL DISRUPTION, their card counts as scoring only when its 1 VP condition is met.

ladder.label: Suppressed or destroyed on an objective

missions.name: ASSASSINATION
missions.objective: Destroy an enemy CHARACTER or MONSTER.

discarded.name: VIGILANT WATCH
discarded.objective: Perform an OVERWATCH Reaction with a unit within an Objective Area.
